content: अनुषञ्ज् (˚सञ्ज्) €1 <ab>P.</ab> To adhere or cling to, follow closely. --{%<ab>pass.</ab>%} ({@-षज्यते@}) .²1 To stick, cling, adhere to, be attached to (<ab>fig.</ab> also); धर्मपूते च मनसि नभसीव न जातु रजोऽनुषज्यते <ls>Dk. 43</ls>; sometimes occurring as अनुषज्जते (from सस्ज् also); यदा हि नेन्द्रियार्थेषु न कर्मस्वनुषज्जते <ls>Bg. 6. 4</ls>, <ls n="Bg.">18. 10</ls>, .²2 To be supplied from a preceding rule or statement. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} .²1 To fasten or attach (something) to. .²2 To supply (as an elliptical expression); इति पदमत्रानुषञ्जनीयम्.
